# Copilot Instructions for Concert

Concert is an npm package (`@he3-org/concert`) that installs AI agent definitions and slash commands into target repositories. It is not a runtime library — it is a CLI tool with three commands: `init`, `update`, and `push`.

## Key Facts

- **Source**: TypeScript, built with `tsup`, tested with `vitest`
- **Entry point**: `src/cli.ts` → commands in `src/commands/`
- **Templates**: `templates/` contains files copied to target repos on `init`
- **Live files**: `.github/agents/` and `.claude/commands/` are copied to target repos on `init` and overwritten on `update`
- **Managed file header**: All Concert-managed files must contain `AUTO-GENERATED BY CONCERT vX.Y.Z` in the first 15 lines. `cleanupStaleFiles()` deletes files with a stale version in this header.
- **Config**: `concert.jsonc` uses JSONC (JSON with comments and trailing commas). Parsed with `jsonc-parser`.
- **Package shipping**: `package.json` `files` array controls what ships. Add new deployable paths there.

## Build, Test, Typecheck

```bash
npm run build        # tsup
npm run test         # vitest run
npx tsc --noEmit     # typecheck only
```

## Architecture

- `src/commands/init.ts` — Copies templates + live files, creates config, appends CLAUDE.md section
- `src/commands/update.ts` — Overwrites live files, merges config/state, cleans up stale files, updates CLAUDE.md
- `src/commands/push.ts` — Git stage, commit, push for session handoffs
- `src/lib/copy.ts` — File copy logic, version stamping, stale file cleanup
- `src/lib/config.ts` — JSONC config read/write/merge
- `src/lib/state.ts` — State JSON read/write
- `src/lib/version.ts` — Package version resolution and header stamping
- `src/lib/merge.ts` — Surgical merge for config and state (add new fields, remove obsolete ones, preserve user values)
